title: The VHIE Liquidity Fabric: Architecting Data for Real-Time Reform
summary: Exploring the transition of the Vermont Health Information Exchange (VHIE) toward a 'Data Liquidity Fabric.' This technical analysis covers the integration of CRISP Shared Services and FHIR-based interoperability.

children.text: Beyond the Repository: Moving to Active Data

Traditional HIEs are static graveyards of PDFs. The new VHIE architecture focuses on technical deflation—reducing the cost of data exchange while increasing the velocity of insights. This is achieved through unified API layers and standardized identity matching.
Technical Note: The shift to FHIR R4 standards is mandatory for all Vermont Medicaid providers by EOY 2026.

body.caption: The new VHIE Technical Architecture: From Silos to Fabric.
